description: Heat Map Data - Substation Areas is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Heat Map data provides the most updated substation by substation information related to our Extra High Voltage (EHV) and High Voltage (HV) network. Data such as firm capacity, max and min demands, existing and contracted generation/demand are used to calculate a thermal headroom figure for demand and generation. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Net Zero Future, Connecting Generation, Connecting Demand. Its keywords are Extra High Voltage (EHV), High Voltage (HV), Connections, Generation, Demand, Network Capacity and Utilisation. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
